subject: general
question: Dheeraj is the only son of Santosh and Santosh is the only daughter of my mother. What is the relationship of my mother with Dheeraj?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8dc8ec26a2a678d56b93cef29b6b80f4ae2dc8c52a3dc06faf8751eadb2c396.png] 

Clearly, my mother is the maternal grandmother of Dheeraj.

Hence, ‘**Maternal grandmother**’ is the correct answer.
